title: Ruth Answers
summary: On Day five, Maya picks up the phone that someone answered.

beats.text: Day five. I lifted the phone before Dev could stop me.
Silence. Then a crackle, and a voice I knew.
"Maya? It is Ruth. I am alive."
beats.speaker: ruth

beats.text: I laughed and cried at the same time. Dev just closed his eyes.
She was in Calder Tower. She crossed the skybridge on thirty when the lobby fell.
"The torch is mine," she said. "I flash it every night to find you."
beats.speaker: ruth

beats.text: "Ask her about the scream," Dev said, very quietly.
beats.speaker: dev

beats.text: "I screamed to pull them away from me. Then I ran. Maya, I never sent that elevator."
beats.speaker: ruth

beats.text: We stared at the empty car. Nobody had called it.
The doors slid shut by themselves, and the number began to fall.
